latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Creator Free 1.0.0 — Turn Text, Images & Ideas Into Polished Videos

- First release: Instantly transforms user scripts, images, or video ideas into shareable, structured video outlines and storyboards.
- No signup required: Handles authentication with free temporary tokens and manages API sessions automatically.
- Supports direct prompts, image uploads, and idea expansion; auto-picks best-generation pipeline for your input.
- User-friendly: Handles backend complexity (session management, API calls, error handling) and keeps the chat simple.
- Cloud-powered: All rendering and processing is managed via the distributed API, supporting popular video and audio formats.
- For creators, educators, and small businesses seeking quick, quality video output — no cost, no editing software needed.
